mapper.insert: insert into sh_report (user_id, idle_id, reported_user_id, reason, content, status, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{idleId}, #{reportedUserId}, #{reason}, #{content}, #{status}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select count(*) from sh_report where status = 0
mapper.update: update sh_report set status = #{status} where id = #{id}
